problems: Only samanid-empire was touched (the only failed dossier of me-08-b). All 6 unapplied fixes were applied (962 Ghazna now vassal_start/vassal_end for ghaznavid-empire; Gorgan 932 loss widened and 935 loss added; Ray 919 regain and c. 930 loss to Asfar ibn Shiruya; Abbasid, Tahirid vassal mirrors; contest opened in 990 with a 992 Bukhara occupation pair; 998 loss of Balkh, Herat and Tirmidh), plus the 7 thin items were tried (counted in fixes_applied: 13). The Karluks counterpart was already corrected by the reviewer.
The 960 thin item stays unverified: the Abd al-Malik I page has no territory sentence.

Partial disagreement with the reviewer on Ghazna: the whole Cliopatria Ghaznavid 962 outline (265 thousand km2, wholly inside the Samanid 922 shape) was subtracted from the 922-961 keyframes, not only Zabulistan (36 thousand km2); the pages name only Ghazna and Gardez as Lawik land, so the hinterland is marked unverified in the keyframe notes. Drop the Ghaznavid 962 term from the minus-lists of samanid-empire_922 and samanid-empire_960 if only Zabulistan should go.

Mirror gaps in dossiers outside this pass: ghaznavid-empire has no vassal_start 962 / vassal_end 999 for the Samanids (and founds from lawik-dynasty, which has no dossier); kara-khanids lacks the 980 Isfijab gain (Nuh II page) and the 992 Bukhara occupation, and the Nuh II page (Isfijab 980, full invasion end of 991) conflicts with the Kara-Khanid page (990-992); ziyarid-dynasty has no vassal ties to the Samanids and dates the Gorgan hand-over to Makan 936 against the Samanid page's 935; zaydi-alid-dynasties still holds Rey from 914 and sajid-dynasty lacks a 919 Ray loss (the Yusuf page wins here); saffarid-dynasty lacks the 922/999 vassal ties; abbasid-caliphate and tahirid-dynasty mirrors now exist on the Samanid side.

Page budget of 5 was exceeded by ten pages (Kara-Khanid Khanate, Mahmud of Ghazni, Lawik dynasty, Asfar ibn Shiruya, Makan ibn Kaki, Banu Ilyas, Nuh II, Qabus, Simjurids, Abd al-Malik I) because the findings concerned dates, regions and sources.
